## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) supplying the *yújiā guānxíng yíguǐ* (yoga-contemplation ritual procedure) for the heart-mantra of *Ārya-Avalokiteśvara* (聖觀自在 = Skt. *Ārya-Avalokiteśvara*, the *non-adorned* form of Avalokiteśvara — distinguished from the *Sahasra-bhuja-Avalokiteśvara* and other proliferated forms). CANWWW alt-titles: *Shèng Guānzìzài yíguǐ* 聖觀自在儀軌, *Yújiā guānxíng guǐyí* 瑜伽觀行軌儀.

**Abstract**

The *Ārya-Avalokiteśvara* heart-mantra (*hṛdaya-mantra*) is one of the simplest and most-recited Avalokiteśvara mantras (typically in the form *oṃ aroḷika svāhā*) and the present text provides its full Esoteric ritual context: *mudrā*-sequence, *maṇḍala*-construction, *guānxíng* (visualisation) procedures, and the doctrinal frame within which the practice is to be undertaken. Together with [KR6j0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0228), [KR6j0230](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0230), and [KR6j0231](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0231) it forms the core of Amoghavajra's Avalokiteśvara liturgical corpus.
